title: Sahabaa bi dëddu .
intro: Yaa ngi waaja wane jaar-jaaru ruuh bu dundu ci lëndëmu yonent ba noppi tànn yoonu yàqu-yàqu. Nit kii dafa bokkoon kër ak kenn ci ndaw yi Yàlla tànn, waaye daa jàllul ci nattum ngëm. Kan mooy wéttal bu réer bii?
clues: Dundoon naa ci diggante nit ñu bañ wooteb njub, te bañoon naa leen.
Dama sëyoon ak yonent Yàlla, waaye bokku ma woon ngëm.
Bi ndaw yi ñëwee ci sama kër ànd ak àrtu, gëmuma leen.
Dañu sant sama jabar mu génn ci dëkk bi ànd ak gëm yi, te man ma bokkul woon ci ñoom.
Daan wi wàcci ci sama askan, ma ànd ak ñoom yàqu.
Dañu ma wax ci Al Quran ni misaalu gëmul, ci wetu jabaru Nuh, ci Suura At-Tahrim.

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
